headline: Trump to embark on Asia trip in apparent foreign policy push before end of term

members.title: Trump to embark on Asia trip in apparent foreign policy push before end of term
members.lead: Experts say US president may lean toward global affairs after domestic influence curtailed in midterm elections Donald Trump is embarking on his first overseas trip since his Republican party’s thumping midterm repudiation by US voters, in what may herald a renewed focus on foreign policy for the remainder of his presidency. The US president will meet his Chinese and Russian counterparts, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin, for their first trilateral summit, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) forum in the Chinese city of Shenzhen. Before that, he will land in Manila in the Philippines on Tuesday for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) summit. Continue reading...

members.title: Xi, Trump and Putin to discuss ‘world peace’ at trilateral, says China
members.lead: Beijing stops short of confirming specific agenda items, but many hope world’s three biggest nuclear powers will talk about denuclearisation The unprecedented meeting of Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen this week will cover topics of “groundbreaking significance” including “safeguarding world peace”, the Chinese foreign ministry has said. The confirmation of Thursday’s trilateral talks, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) summit, cements Xi’s status as a global powerbroker as he presides over events in the glittering southern tech hub of Shenzhen.
